mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_device ( user_id, device_no, app_version, platform, app_package, fcm_token, permission_status, last_seen_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{deviceNo}, #{appVersion}, #{platform}, #{appPackage}, #{fcmToken}, #{permissionStatus}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), app_version = VALUES(app_version), platform = VALUES(platform), fcm_token = VALUES(fcm_token), permission_status = VALUES(permission_status), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at)
